instructions: 1. Say to your AI: "Hold an output back, and give the person's own support resources instead, when its risk is too high or unknown", and give it threshold.
2. The AI calls run_resource_operation at @workshop-tools with method tools:run, tool tool:hold-back-on-risk and its input (the worked example shows one).
3. Read what comes back: Takes a risk assessment (was it run, the risk from 0 to 1 or null, categories) and the person's threshold.
